About.intro: I'm Nahuel, a full-stack developer who builds real products end-to-end — from the interfaces users touch to the databases behind them. I've shipped a production tutoring platform (Entienda y Aprenda) and data-driven tools like Torino City Intelligence, and I'm always exploring how AI can make development faster and products smarter.
About.goalsText: Keep building products that solve real problems for real people — and keep learning how AI lets a small team ship what used to take a big one.
